scripts.build: mkdir -p dist www && (if [ -f index.html ]; then cp index.html dist/index.html && cp index.html www/index.html; fi) && (if [ -f terms.html ]; then cp terms.html dist/terms.html && cp terms.html www/terms.html; fi) && (if [ -f manifest.json ]; then cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp manifest.json www/manifest.json; fi) && (if [ -d assets ]; then cp -r assets dist/ && cp -r assets www/; fi) && (if [ -d www ] && [ -f www/index.html ]; then cp -r www/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi) && (if [ -d android/app/src/main/assets/public ]; then cp -r dist/* android/app/src/main/assets/public/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi)
scripts.lint: echo 'No linting needed for pure HTML app'
